column3: Retains the blessing with you and does not repeat the LORD your God as the subject of blessing.
Retains the name being called over you.
Retains good storehouse and your hand in the singular.
Retains being above and below rather than movement upward and downward.
Retains the shift to plural you in I command you and the purpose of following other gods.
Retains the voice of the LORD your God.
Retains the curse in the singular and forsaking Me.
Retains the singular him in going out and fleeing.
Retains your corpse in the singular.
Retains causing your ways to prosper.
Retains the active betrothing and lying with her.
